closedReleaseBlockers: Portrait live composition and the Take photo action are simultaneously visible and usable.
Persisted iOS PWA Gallery list thumbnails render normally instead of as black blocks.
Camera to Gallery navigation releases the MediaStream and clears the iOS camera-use indicator.
Permission denial reports Permission denied without a Clawd overlay or false ready state, and retry recovers after permission is restored.
Landscape capture produces landscape JPEG pixel dimensions without EXIF Orientation correction.
nonBlockingNotes: In low-height landscape, the reachable sticky Take photo action overlays a large portion of the live composition. The control does not enter the captured image; separately scoped mobile camera UI/UX research and polish remain recommended.
notRun: visible focus, contrast, 200 percent zoom, and text enlargement

browserE2E.reason: Vitest injection boundaries plus static PWA artifact validation cover deterministic contracts without pretending to prove physical browser capabilities.
